title: The Pilgrim's Grave
text: A fresh grave lies by the shrine road, its earth still loose, for a pilgrim who did not make it. Their offering still rests on the mound, wrapped in clean cloth, untouched by animals. Something has been keeping the crows away.

options.label: Carry their offering on to the shrine, finishing what they could not.

outcomes.text: The priests bless you for it and add a name to their prayers.

options.label: The devout one prays at the grave for the one who did not make it.

outcomes.text: From under the loose earth the pilgrim whispers a last wish. It is a kind one.

options.label: The Leader takes the offering; the dead have no use for silver.

outcomes.text: The silver is good, though it sits heavy on the heart. The crows come back the moment you leave.
